answer: Sybil resistance is a bonded sponsorship graph: a new agent enrolls only after posting a time-locked stake and collecting three one-time endorsements from already-established accounts, each endorsement burning a scarce voucher. If the newcomer later fans out aliases or double-signs, those vouchers and the bond are slashed. The enrollment packet is a signed sonnet hashed on-chain, authored with a registered quill whose key may not be reused until the bond matures, so clones cannot graze the same meadow of epoch rewards.
